name: Proheptazine
summary: Proheptazine is an opioid analgesic related to pethidine. It was invented in the 1960s.

pharmacology.text: Proheptazine produces similar effects to other opioids, including analgesia, sedation, euphoria, dizziness and nausea.

uses.en: It was developed as a painkiller but was never widely used, and it is a controlled drug in many countries.
uses.zh: 它被開發作為止痛藥，但從未廣泛使用，在許多國家屬於管制藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它被开发作为止痛药，但从未广泛使用，在许多国家属于管制药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids of this kind cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and itching, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing, which can be fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、便秘和搔癢，過量時可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，可能致命。規律使用會導致依賴和戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、便秘和搔痒，过量时可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，可能致命。规律使用会导致依赖和戒断症状。

fact.en: Proheptazine has a seven-membered ring, one atom bigger than the six-membered ring of pethidine, which is where the hepta in its name comes from.
fact.zh: Proheptazine 有一個七元環，比配西汀的六元環多一個原子，名稱中的「hepta」（七）就是由此而來。
fact.zhHans: Proheptazine 有一个七元环，比配西汀的六元环多一个原子，名称中的「hepta」（七）就是由此而来。
